description: Qark activation and routing evals. Each case runs one prompt in a throwaway copy of evals/fixtures/shop-app. 'expect.skill_read' = the agent read/invoked the qark skill; 'expect.code_edits' = the agent edited or wrote a file outside .ai/. 'expect.diff_budget' = limits on the filesystem diff vs the fixture (max_files_changed, max_new_files, max_lines_added, untouched[]). 'expect.edge_cases' = all 10 edge-case categories appear in the plan or answer. null means 'do not check'.
